Adrian(笑疯了）：You stupid bitch. Are you still holding a grudge against Caius? Hahahaha! Caius had no idea healing him would kill you! He was busy planning your damn wedding!

Adrian：You're so slow, brother. Her heart is failing because she absorbed your Alpha Rage curse to heal you. Six years ago, I told her you knew about it all along—that you were just using her, and once you were cured, you'd toss her aside. Hahahaha! And the stupid bitch actually bought it!

Caius看向Iris，他的眼里有着惊愕：So that's why you left me?
